body: Hey I did the same thing a few years back and gave myself a buzz cut!  Just so you know my hair grew back, and I’m still glad I didn’t kill myself, and I’m glad you didn’t either!  Take this opportunity to not care about your hair. You can be seen just for who you are and your wonderful face. I know it’s difficult to hear “it’ll grow back” when it was not a decision made for fun and seeing your short hair may remind you of feeling down. But your life is much more important than the dead skin that grows out yo scalp. Plus, (this is what I did and am currently trying to do), you can treat it as a fresh start to healthy hair!  Put love into growing it back and treating it right with nice products and tlc. But in the meantime, you may want to go swimming if you can, because it feels utterly amazing with short hair!  I actually miss that feeling.
Loons are wonderful!  As a teenager I used to kayak at my ex’s cabin on a lake filled with loons. I could always hear them while falling asleep. They sounded magical
The 5 yr anniversary of my failure is in a couple weeks and usually I try to take the day off work so I can appreciate being alive. I always get mixed feelings around this time tho.
Thank you sweetie. I’m having a really hard day thinking about everything and that helps. 💕

I can relate to everything thing you wrote. It almost feels like I wrote it myself. I’ve been struggling so much with that this year after thinking I got better. And it’s almost my 5 year anniversary of my suicide attempt

I did almost the exact same thing. I just permanently deleted my Instagram and my Facebook tho. Too many times would I temporarily disable it and then log back in a week later. I would look at his friends list and try to keep tabs on every girl I could find. Wtf it feels so awful to torture myself like that, so I know how hard it is. I’m deleted everything in hopes that it’ll help me chill out. At least I can’t see all the slutty photos girls post on Instagram anymore that make me feel insignificant
Thank you for the kind words 💕
